# Security policy

## Supported versions

Văzute is maintained from the `main` branch. Security fixes are applied to the
latest deployed release; older releases are not supported separately.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Email
[984.alexmihai@gmail.com](mailto:984.alexmihai@gmail.com) with:

- the affected URL, API route, app version, or source revision;
- reproducible steps and the security impact;
- the smallest proof of concept needed to demonstrate the issue;
- any relevant logs or screenshots, with credentials and personal data removed;
- a way to contact you for follow-up.

An acknowledgement is targeted within three business days and a substantive
status update within ten business days. Complex fixes may take longer. Please
coordinate public disclosure until a fix is available to affected users.

## Safe testing

Good-faith research against accounts and data you own is welcome when it avoids
harm. Do not:

- access, modify, retain, or disclose another person's data;
- degrade availability, run denial-of-service tests, or create excessive load;
- use social engineering, spam, malware, persistence, or physical attacks;
- exfiltrate secrets or data beyond the minimum evidence required;
- continue testing after confirming a vulnerability or after being asked to stop.

If you encounter personal data or a live secret, stop, preserve no additional
copies, and report it immediately. This policy does not authorize violations of
law or third-party terms.

Văzute does not currently operate a paid bug-bounty program. Good-faith reports
that follow this policy will not be pursued merely for bypassing a technical
control while demonstrating the vulnerability responsibly.
